fieldValues.title: Text Projection includes only Fields matching the RFC-032 searchability predicate
fieldValues.normative_statement: For Tier 2, the Text Projection MUST include a Field only when `fieldType.datatype == "string"` and `fieldType.format` is absent or one of `"plain"`, `"markdown"`, or `"uri"`. `valueDomain` does not affect searchability. A single-cardinality Field emits one segment; a list-cardinality Field emits one segment per array element in order. Fields with `format: "uuid"` or `format: "email"`, or datatype `number`, `integer`, `boolean`, `date`, `date-time`, `ref`, `dependent`, or `map`, MUST NOT contribute `TextSegment`s. Tier-1 `TypedField.valueType` continues to use the legacy classification until the #242 Phase-B carrier cutover. (RFC-012 R8; RFC-032 Rev-7 erratum.)
